verdict.rationale: Bolna's own Agent Studio turns a short use-case description into a call-ready voice agent with no prompt engineering, which covers AI-assisted agent and prompt generation. The evidence is a single doc line, and it does not show the AI improving existing prompts, designing flows, or generating test cases. Missing for 10: AI improvement or rewriting of existing prompts, explicit flow generation, AI-generated test cases or evaluation scenarios, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description

citations.quote: Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes. No prompt engineering, no guesswork.
